jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Draw ONLY a wearable scarf accessory tailored to the exact bee in image 1; image 2 is approved scarf identity. Same coral-orange chunky faceted scarf, one curved substantial fabric wrap, compact knot and two short downward tails at image-RIGHT end. Camera strict frontal; wrap symmetrically foreshortened except right knot. Fit the rounded cream bee BELOW its cream collar; substantial soft band following the rounded chest. CRITICAL the left edge curves UP and BACK around body, the entire wrap has a shallow natural downward front arc with both ends higher, NO exposed abrupt flat cut or open rolled hollow loop at left. Hidden rear return is behind body and must not be depicted as a giant floating circular donut. Knot and tails attach at right-side curve, not floating. Same broad irregular facets, restrained warm lighting, no microtriangles. Proportions: front band width about four times its fabric thickness, tails only half band thickness long. Match warm top-left lighting and material reference, no new pattern or embellishments. No body, bee, collar, fur, antennas, wings, letters, shadows, glow or backdrop. Single standalone artwork, all holes transparent, genuine transparent background. Entire item centered with padding; do not draw mannequin.
jobs.repairPrompt: Edit ONLY this standalone scarf shape to be substantially LOWER and WIDER in silhouette, tailoring it to a rounded game bee torso.
